description: The chart illustrates the popularity of different categories across three models, Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT, with a focus on the distribution of "Acc=0 & GT Ans" and "Acc=0 & Gene Ans" within each category. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled as "Movies", "Songs", and "Basketball", in a fixed order. The vertical axis is labeled "Popularity" and has a linear scale ranging from 20 to 220, with tick labels at intervals of 40. Each category is represented by a group of six bars, with two bars for each model, distinguished by different colors (blue for Llama3, red for Qwen2, and yellow for ChatGPT) and patterns (dotted for "Acc=0 & GT Ans" and striped for "Acc=0 & Gene Ans"). The bars for "Movies" have approximate values ranging from 25 to 40, those for "Songs" range from around 40 to 80, and those for "Basketball" range from approximately 100 to 210. The bars within each group are not sorted in a specific order, but the categories are presented in a consistent order across all models. The chart does not visually emphasize any particular bar or category.
